observations: Photo 0: a disassembled automotive transmission/gearbox casing lying on dirty ground, shot from above, with mounting bolts, a wiring harness, and a sensor connector visible.
Photo 0: a person's rubber boots are visible at the bottom edge for scale.
Photo 1: same or similar gearbox unit shot at a lower angle indoors, showing a solenoid/sensor with a red cap, wiring, and a seatbelt-like strap draped over it.
No casting numbers, part numbers, or brand/model markings are legible in either photo.
No photo shows the input/output shafts, bellhousing bolt pattern, or any ID plate.
No video or audio of the gearbox turning, shifting, or being tested is provided.
Watermark 'DE EKESON MOTORS / POSTED ON JIJI' overlays both images; this is a listing watermark, not proof of the item's origin.

claims.evidence: No Toyota logo, casting number, or part number is visible in photo 0 or photo 1 to confirm make/model fitment.
No date code, casting stamp, or VIN tag is visible in either photo.
Casing, wiring, and some connectors are visible in photo 0 and photo 1, but shafts, bellhousing interior, and mechatronic/valve body (if automatic) are not shown, so completeness cannot be confirmed.
Grading claims require inspection or a dealer certificate; no such document or close-up of wear surfaces is shown.

risks.risk: Internal gear/clutch/mechatronic condition unknown; could be seized, worn, or fault-coded.
risks.proof: A video of the output shaft turning freely by hand, or a bench/vehicle test clip showing it shifting.

risks.risk: Actual make/model fitment cannot be confirmed from photos, so it may not match a Toyota Corolla as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the casting number or part number stamped on the case.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unconfirmed-fitment used gearbox, not Corolla-specific

risks.risk: Mileage and fluid condition (contamination, burnt smell, metal shavings) cannot be seen.
risks.proof: A photo of the drained fluid on a dipstick or in a pan, and odometer reading of the donor vehicle if available.

risks.risk: Missing internal components (solenoids, sensors, valve body parts) not visible from the exterior shots.
risks.proof: Photos of the open bellhousing and, if automatic, the valve body/mechatronic unit.

risks.proof: Photo of the donor vehicle or a chassis/VIN plate.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the casting/part number stamped on the gearbox case.
A video of the shaft turning freely or the unit shifting through gears.
Photo of the transmission fluid color/condition.
Photo of the open bellhousing or valve body to confirm completeness.
response.reason: The photos show a used transmission assembly whose make, model, and internal condition cannot be confirmed, so it is identified and priced as a generic used gearbox of unconfirmed fitment and unproven function at worst case.
